castle_guide.text: Harlech Castle! King Edward's lot built it by the sea so supplies could arrive by boat.
Then the sea went and moved a mile away. Medieval planning, folks.

dolphin_spotter.text: Cardigan Bay has the biggest bottlenose dolphin colony in the UK. They're a Special Area of Conservation.
Which is lovely. Lasts until a gull lands on a buoy and I start shouting 'dolphin' for no reason.

toll_keeper.text: Barmouth Bridge. The railway goes over it too, and the bridge swings open for tall boats.
Used to. Mostly now it just swings open for my opinions.

hermit.text: Oh! A visitor. Brilliant swimming, or did you wade? Not many wade.
I came here for peace and quiet. There's a lot of quiet. The peace has gone out for chips.

farmer.text: Cadair Idris means 'the chair of Idris', a giant who liked a good view.
My sheep call it Tuesday. Same hills, same weather. Lovely, mind.

borth_walker.text: Borth! The sea sometimes uncovers a whole drowned forest of oak and pine stumps. Proper ancient.
People say it's the lost kingdom of Cantre'r Gwaelod. The bells still ring under the waves, apparently. I've never heard them. Bad ears.

arts_ysgwrn_guide.text: {greeting} I show people round Yr Ysgwrn, Hedd Wyn's farmhouse up at Trawsfynydd. The Black Chair is in the parlour, where his family kept it for a century, under a cloth.

He was a shepherd who wrote poems in the fields. The army took him in 1917; he finished 'Yr Arwr', the Hero, in a camp in Flanders and posted it to the Eisteddfod. He was dead five weeks before the judges read it.

When they called the winner's name three times and nobody stood, the whole pavilion knew. They draped the chair in black. His nephew Gerald kept the farm and showed the chair to anybody who knocked, for sixty years. Now it is my turn.

then.text: No kites over the top fields this spring. I keep looking up. You'd think I'd be pleased.
I've a kite on my gate most mornings. We've reached an understanding. I'm not telling anyone.
Kites over the feeding post by the dozen. The neighbours without a shed are not speaking to us.
Tag Seven's off in somebody's team. The sky's gone quiet, and I haven't decided how I feel.
